title_en: Artificial Intelligence (16/20): A Robot Dog at Home
note_en: 既……也…… links two qualities or actions, like "both... and..." or, with negatives, "neither... nor...": 既不用担心过敏，也不用每天遛狗 "no need to worry about allergies, and no need to walk a dog every day," and 机器狗既不会咬人，也不会乱叫 "the robot dog neither bites nor barks for no reason." Note that the negative goes inside each half (既不……也不……), whereas English puts the negation into "neither/nor" itself.
